title: Naseeb: The Jeep Driver
shortDescription: You are Naseeb, a jeep driver in the far north. Prove your old jeep on an off-road test ground, with real physics.
description: You are Naseeb, a jeep driver in the far north. Prove your old army-green jeep on an off-road test ground: washboard, logs, an axle twister, rock steps, a 40% hill, a 25° side slope, a V-ditch, a mud pit, a rock garden, a sand trap and whoops. The jeep is built up from its tires with real physics: a straight six, three gears in high and low range, part-time four-wheel drive, leaf springs, tires that climb edges and grip along slopes, and a chassis that scrapes. With engine and tire sounds made from the physics.
howToPlay: Hold the throttle to drive; the automatic picks the gear.
Press 1 to 6 to choose a gear yourself, 0 to hand back to the automatic, R for reverse.
Brake with Space or the brake pedal.
Steer with the arrow keys or the on-screen buttons.
Jump to a surface with the chips at the bottom and see how the grip changes.
Turn on Forces to see the weight, the ground pushing back and the friction at each tire.

touch.gesture: Tap a gear above the pedals
Drag the scene; pinch to zoom
